  children={"Read contest submission events"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/contests/{id}/events"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns metadata-only events ordered by occurred_at, oldest first,
with event UUID as the tie-breaker for equal timestamps.
Each event describes a submission entering the contest, a change to its
visible log fields, or its withdrawal. Changes outside this contest do
not appear. Recording starts when the feature is enabled; existing logs
do not receive fabricated historical submission events.

Omit cursor or use 0 to read from the beginning. Use now once to obtain
an empty page with the latest visible event ID, or 0 for an empty feed.
Otherwise pass a retained event ID to read strictly after that event.
Event UUIDs are stable deduplication keys. The server resolves a cursor
ID to its stored (occurred_at, id) pair; consumers use response order.
occurred_at is the source operation's timestamp, stored once at creation.
Occurrence order is not commit order: a transaction that commits late
can appear before an already-consumed cursor. Forward polling alone
does not guarantee delivery of those late events.

A nonempty page's next_cursor is its final event ID. An ordinary empty
page preserves the supplied event ID, or 0 when starting at the
beginning. Save the cursor only after processing the page. When
has_more is false, poll later using that same cursor. Retrying can
repeat events. Events are retained for the lifetime of the contest.

Uses the same public read access as the contest log list. A cursor
never grants access to another contest or tenant. Fetch current log
contents separately through this contest's log endpoint; event records
contain no log contents or historical snapshots.
